label: yddG
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the yddG window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yddG, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,250 to 2,329 from dnaA. Read in 531 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yddG once); 42,480 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 87% of genes, 0.61 bits on average (perplexity 1.9 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 24,035 calls, named 95%, 0.25 bits; shell 17,831 calls, named 78%, 0.97 bits; cloud 614 calls, named 9%, 4.40 bits. Outside an RGP 28,403 calls, named 93%, 0.33 bits; inside an RGP 14,077 calls, named 74%, 1.18 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 71 fork, 8 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.18 against 0.33 bits) and names fewer genes (74% against 93%); 14,077 of the 42,480 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 12 (ydcD, a fork column) 1.99 bits, RGP 90%; column 11 ("protein YncO", a fork column) 1.78 bits, RGP 85%; column 13 (rhsD, a fork column) 1.58 bits, RGP 89%. The 28 columns (columns 10-16 and 59-79) where most calls are in an RGP: named 81%, 0.84 bits on average; the other 52 columns: named 90%, 0.48 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 1 spine column: named 98%, 0.24 bits on average; the 79 fork and variable columns: named 87%, 0.61 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 12, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: yddG "aromatic amino acid efflux DMT tran…". named 98%; 0.24 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: share 5-85%, 40 P, 39 S, RGP 1-90%. named 63-98% (mean 87%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 12, named 63%, 1.99 bits.
